# Midnight Invoice

> Invoice generator with an agent API. AI agents can connect to a user's
> workspace (after the user approves them) and create, read, update and
> delete invoices and saved clients, read default sender settings and
> download PDFs. To invoice a saved client, look it up (GET
> /api/v1/clients?q=… or MCP list_clients) and pass its id as `clientId`;
> the server fills its name, address, email and default terms. When the
> user mentions a template or a recurring invoice, find it (GET
> /api/v1/templates?q=… or MCP list_templates) and create the invoice with
> POST /api/v1/templates/:id/instantiate (MCP create_invoice_from_template):
> a draft with the template's lines and terms, placeholders such as
> {{month_name}} resolved for the issue date.

## Connect an agent (device flow, no browser login needed)

1. POST /api/v1/agents/register with {"name", "description"?, "scopes": [...]}
   Scopes: invoices:read, invoices:write, invoices:delete, settings:read,
   clients:read, clients:write, templates:read, templates:write
2. Show the user `user_code` and `verification_url_complete`; they approve it in the app.
3. Poll POST /api/v1/agents/token with {"device_code"} every `interval` seconds
   until it returns {"api_key"} (errors: authorization_pending, slow_down,
   access_denied, expired_token). The key is shown once.
4. Send `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>` on every request.

## What is unpaid?

- GET /api/v1/invoices/summary: counts and totals per currency (draft, outstanding, overdue, paid this month/year)
- GET /api/v1/invoices?status=overdue (also draft, sent, paid, void; comma list), due_before, due_after, client
- POST /api/v1/invoices/:id/mark-sent | mark-paid | void | reopen (scope invoices:write)
- MCP: list_invoices (same filters), get_invoice_summary, set_invoice_status

## Docs

- [OpenAPI 3.1](/api/v1/openapi.json): full REST contract
- [MCP endpoint](/api/mcp): remote MCP server (Streamable HTTP, stateless, POST, same Bearer key)
- Agent guide: AGENT_API.md in the source repository (https://github.com/0xzapata/midnight-invoice/blob/main/AGENT_API.md)
